TextToSpeechConfigV2.description:
Thin, DB-referencing TTS config — the ``"2.0"`` variant stored in the
SAME ``app.text_to_speech_config`` column as the legacy fat config,
discriminated by ``config_version``.

Deliberately does NOT inherit ``BaseConfig``: that sets
``use_enum_values=True`` (unwanted here) and does not set
``extra="forbid"``. Plain ``BaseModel`` keeps the surface tight.

Serialization consequence: without ``use_enum_values=True``,
``model_dump()`` returns ``UUID`` objects and enum members, which
``json.dumps`` cannot write into authoring's ``sa.JSON`` column. Anything
that persists this must use ``model_dump(mode="json")`` or
``model_dump_json()``. Reading back is fine — pydantic parses the strings.
TextToSpeechConfigV2.title: TextToSpeechConfigV2
